title: Console: Usage Insights routes page (table, filters, sparklines) behind feature flag
author: Felix Schneider
description: Summary: Adds the initial Usage Insights → Routes page in the Console. This is the "top cost drivers by route" entry point (table + filters + spend sparklines + basic summary tiles). The page is gated behind a feature flag and uses the new insights API route list endpoint introduced in the backend work. This does not include export (separate PR) and does not include the route detail page (separate PR). Feature flag: usage_insights_routes_v1 (off by default). Motivation: Customers (and internal FinOps) need a quick way to answer “what routes are costing us the most?” and to see week-over-week changes. This PR focuses on the list view IA from DES-211: route ranking + quick filters + lightweight trend context to identify spikes. UX overview: - New nav entry (hidden behind flag): Console → Usage → Insights (beta) → Routes - Table columns: Route, Total cost, Input tokens cost, Output tokens cost, Cached tokens, p95 latency, Error rate, Trend (sparkline for total cost) - Sorting: default by Total cost desc; user can sort by any numeric column - Pagination: cursor-based from API; page size 50 (hard-coded for now per query cost budget) - Filters: time range (last 24h / 7d / 30d + custom), environment, region, org/project (existing global scoping), deployment mode (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) - Empty states: (a) no data for time window, (b) data present but all routes are Unknown route → CTA to docs once available, (c) permission denied (RBAC) - Loading states: skeleton rows + keep previous data while refetching on filter changes - Basic tiles above the table: Total cost, Total requests, Avg unit cost (derived) for the selected window (note: values are approximate until metering settles; copy included) Screenshots: - Routes page (default sort by cost): https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/redwood/15470/routes-table.png - Filters expanded + custom time range: https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/redwood/15470/filters.png - Empty state (no routes tagged): https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/redwood/15470/empty-unknown-route.png Implementation details: - Frontend stack: React + TypeScript; data fetching via react-query; charts via Recharts (small sparkline component) - URL state: filters + sort state are encoded in the query string (so links are shareable); time range is represented as {start,end,granularity} and normalized on load - API client: adds typed client wrapper for GET /v1/insights/routes (response + pagination cursor) - Guardrails: - Caps route display length to 80 chars in the table (full value in tooltip) - Shows "(normalized)" badge when backend indicates route was normalized/hashed (field exists but currently always false on staging; wiring in place) - Fails closed on unexpected high-cardinality UI issues: if >10k distinct routes in window, API returns an error code; UI maps to a friendly message and prompts to narrow window Backend dependency notes: - Expects API schema from ENG-8423 to be available. For local dev, mock server fixtures are included. - The "trend" sparkline uses the API-provided timeseries for top N routes. If backend returns no timeseries, UI falls back to a flat line and hides the legend. What’s not in this PR: - Export flow (ENG-8425) - Route detail page (ENG-8427) - Anomaly detection (explicit non-goal) - Custom dimensions beyond route/model Testing: - Unit tests for filter parsing + URL state: console-web/src/pages/usageInsights/routes/__tests__/filters.test.ts - Component tests for table sorting + pagination: console-web/src/pages/usageInsights/routes/__tests__/routesTable.test.tsx - Manual: verified against staging with seeded data for Hosted + Dedicated; verified RBAC with a restricted project role (403 maps to "You don’t have access") Rollout plan: - Land behind feature flag off-by-default - Enable for internal dogfood orgs first (Console team + Telemetry team) - Beta partners enabled via org-level flag once export + detail page are live Follow-ups / TODOs: - Replace hard-coded “Unknown route” docs link once docs PR merges (ENG-8431) - Add keyboard focus order + aria-label tuning for filters (tracked in DES-211 comments) - Performance: virtualize table if we increase page size beyond 50 (not needed yet) Changed areas (high level): - console-web/src/routes.ts (new route under /usage/insights/routes behind flag) - console-web/src/pages/usageInsights/routes/* (page, filters, table, sparkline) - console-web/src/api/usageInsights.ts (typed client + zod schema validation) - console-web/src/components/FeatureFlagGate.tsx (minor: supports org-scoped gate + tooltip) - console-web/src/styles/* (small additions for table density + sparklines) Commit summary: 1) Add usage insights route + feature flag gate 2) Implement filters + URL sync 3) Add routes table + sorting/pagination 4) Add sparklines + summary tiles 5) Tests + empty/loading states Review notes / conversation (abridged): - Tessa Morgan (Design): “Table density looks good; can we make the filter pills consistent with Rollouts?” → Updated to use existing FilterChip component and aligned spacing. - Dylan Brooks: “Make sure flag is off by default and no nav leakage.” → Confirmed; route is only registered when flag is true; added a unit test that nav item doesn’t appear when disabled. - Chloe Martin: “Watch query fan-out for sparklines.” → Updated to request timeseries only for top 10 routes (API supports include_timeseries + timeseries_limit). - Allison Grant (SRE): “Please add a basic client-side timeout message; staging can be slow.” → Added 20s timeout mapping to “Insights are taking longer than usual” and preserved retry/backoff from shared query defaults. CI: - web:lint ✅ - web:test ✅ - web:build ✅ - typecheck ✅ - e2e-smoke ✅ Merge: Squash merged to main after approvals. Release note: Console (beta): Added Usage Insights “Routes” page to rank spend by route with filters and basic trends (feature-flagged).
